items: The Church’s history: slavery, colonialism and anti-Judaism
why: How Christians have read what the apostles say to slaves and masters, and when the Church came to condemn slavery.
The Bible condones slavery, so it can’t be trusted morally.
Paul sends a runaway slave back to his master and asks that he be received as a brother.
notes: The apostles write to slaves and to masters in a world where slavery was normal. They do not call for its abolition, and they say that in Christ master and slave are brothers. Philemon is the clearest case.
